entities.summary: Davor Palo is a Danish chess Grandmaster. Having obtained the title in 2005 at the age of 19, he is the second youngest grandmaster in the history of Denmark, behind Jonas Buhl Bjerre and ahead of Bent Larsen. He is originally from Bosnia and Herzegovina.
